answer: Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 12 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the vine. Promotion is logged in nectar and inlet recomputes the tiers from replay. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, which means a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. A 277 account operation therefore ties up 9 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
